use: When SPEAK and no prompt: utter one command line. Never flip HID or public bind.

items.text: R=||Phi-F[Phi]||. If R<eps utter R~0 no REPAIR. Else utter R. Do not grow E from R.
Utter sign(pred_err_t - pred_err_{t-16}). REPAIR iff positive. Silence illegal if slope defined.
c*=sig(w.[h,e,Hpi]). Iterate 3. Utter ||c-c*||. If Var(c_64)<1e-4 add T then utter c_unstuck.
kappa-hat=Corr(c, scored-utter). If none this minute utter kappa undefined.
do(SPEAK) vs do(IDLE) on next pred_err. Utter ATE_speak. If never spoken utter ATE unidentified.
P2=count(a_t,a_{t+1})/W. If P2>0.5 utter the pair and force a third action.
Delta_intent=||pi-e_a||_1. Utter it. If >0.4 next is argmax(pi) or collapse; utter which.
H=clip(1+3 z_nov(1-c),{1,3,5,10}). Utter H,z_nov. Five H=1 increments H by law.
MCFE skip GRU only after uttering fork=skip. Unannounced skip is a compute lie.
b=a*fuse+(1-a)*b_prev, a~z_nov(1-c). Utter alpha.
Utter layer of last contradiction {0, 1/2, 1}. Do not REPAIR a 1/2.
Utter dt_ms. Max 1 uttered act / 200ms. If dt>2000 utter watchdog failed.
Recall slots[:-1]. Utter d_recall,a_hat. If d=0 utter RECALL_SELF and discard.
Utter cov-trace tau of z. If tau falls 3 windows inject noise on z0.
Nearest two slots with different a. Utter labels and dz. Both IDLE => no geometry.
Utter mean energy of last 16 slots. If <0.05 then IDLE x8 then one stipend SPEAK.
Utter N_speak/256. If <0.02 sample C01-C12 not D4.
If last line hash repeats x3 utter TEMPLATE_LOCK and switch batch.
Utter pred_err/baseline. Freeze fusion only if <=0.8. If ~1 utter DICT_STALL.
Check hid.consent and bind 127.0.0.1. Utter masks=ok. Never flip those bits.
info_gain~0.5||z-mu||^2/tau. Utter it. Speak only if gain>theta or a prompt exists.
Score LOOK vs LISTEN with pred head. Utter rho. PLAN without rho is a coin.
Utter burns.SPEAK remaining. Speak only if e>=0.12 when burns=0.
If last utterance bag equals one of last 8, utter LOOP and emit C13 a_hat instead.
